The vin2 path is the problem. Its gain is set by Rf/R2 = 1000 / 8.27e6 ≈ 1.21e-4, which matches the simulated -1.148e-4. The target band (-2.066e-3 to -2.525e-3) implies R2 ≈ 1000 / 2.3e-3 ≈ 435 kΩ, so R2 is roughly 19× too large.

The vin1 path is healthy: Rf/R1 = 1000 / 132529 ≈ 7.5e-3, and the simulated -7.163e-3 is within the target band. Rf is not the culprit because a change there would also shift a1. The other specs (power, bandwidth, offset) pass, so the op-amp core is unlikely to be the fault.
